items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Well, he had me, Punch, Georgia Boyd, and Charlie Moore.

ctx.x: What about Jack Carey's band? Who did Jack have in his band? Should he have you and Punch and Toka?

Well, he had me, Punch, Georgia Boyd, and Charlie Moore. And Jimmy Johnson. You worked on the Jimmy Johnson. Mm-hmm. That was a pay-polling band. But he didn't have a sick piece. And whenever he'd get a job, whether that's been on, he'd always hire horses. Horses, huh?
